products.name: KariKari Garlic Chili Crisp, 16oz
products.description:
Husband and wife duo Rob Griset and Ruby Sparks developed the recipe for KariKari Garlic Chili Crisp in their tiny apartment on Seattle’s Capitol Hill in 2019. The pepper blend brings a compelling heat, while crisp bits of garlic, shallot, and peanut add crunchy texture and bold flavor. Rounded out with a hint of soy and mushroom for an umami finish, each bite is at once sweet, spicy, savory, and wonderfully complex.

After stirring the jar from the bottom, add a bit to your next stir-fry, rice bowl, or ramen for instantly elevated flavor. KariKari Garlic Chili Crisp also great with mac and cheese, fried eggs, roasted meats or veggies, or just about anything that benefits from a bit of heat and savory flavor. Try it yourself and see why it’s become an instant staff favorite – but be warned, you may find yourself with a new must-have condiment!

products.description: Kozlik's Canadian Mustard was established in 1948 and has remains family owned and operated to this day, producing hand-made mustard in small batches. Their recipe has not changed in over 60 years, nor has their commitment to sourcing the finest quality ingredients to make the best-tasting mustard possible. Their Horseradish Mustard is made with hot white horseradish. Hot and spicy, it pairs well with roast beef, chicken, sausages, grilled meats and sandwiches.

products.name: Kozlik's Sweet & Smokey Mustard, 250g
products.description: Kozlik's Canadian Mustard was established in 1948 and has remains family owned and operated to this day, producing hand-made mustard in small batches. Their recipe has not changed in over 60 years, nor has their commitment to sourcing the finest quality ingredients to make the best-tasting mustard possible. Their Sweet and Smoky mustard is a house favorite. Made with honey, hickory and garlic, it delivers that perfect barbeque taste. Try it with grilled sausages & peppers, or on a classic ham sandwich.

products.name: Kozlik's Triple Crunch Mustard, 250g
products.description: Kozlik's Canadian Mustard was established in 1948 and has remains family owned and operated to this day, producing hand-made mustard in small batches. Their recipe has not changed in over 60 years, nor has their commitment to sourcing the finest quality ingredients to make the best-tasting mustard possible. Their Triple Crunch is truly unique. Taste and texture come together in this blend of three different types of whole mustard seed, Canadian whisky and honey. Flavorful but not spicy, it is perfect as a rub on pork roasts, along side creamy pate or even with raw oysters.

products.name: Villa Jerada Chermoula Spread, 9oz
products.description: Medhi Boujrada, founder of Villa Jerada, has spent the past decade sharing his love for his native Morocco’s cuisine. His meticulously sourced spices and other ingredients can be found on the menus of Seattle restaurants such as Mamnoon and L’Oursin. Their flagship import, Atlas Olive Oil, has become a favorite of chefs, home cooks and the shelves at DeLaurenti. With an unflinching focus on quality and authenticity, Villa Jerada offers some of the finest Moroccan and Levantinian foods in Seattle. Their chermoula spread is an aromatic blend of sundried tomatoes, spices, and preserved lemon. Similar to tapenade, it can be used to season fish, meats, or vegetables, or enjoyed with cheese and crackers. A Good Food Awards 2021 Finalist, this savory, tangy spread is your secret to the taste of Morocco.

products.name: Villa Jerada Harissa Sauce, 170.1g
products.description: In every Moroccan Souk, store and home you will find this spicy condiment used as either a base for cooking, or as a garnish to add spice to your meal. Harissa remains a staple in the Moroccan kitchen, much like Ketchup, Tabasco or Siracha is for many American homes. Villa Jerada’s harissa stands out amongst other brands because of its unique flavor and quality. With beautifully red chilis, a half a preserved lemon and an abundance of organic Moroccan extra virgin olive oil in every jar, you will taste the difference. The applications of this amazing sauce are too numerous to list - vegetables, sauces, braised meats, soups...the list goes on. Any time you find yourself craving rich chili flavor with a bit of spice, just add some.

products.name: Villa Jerada Preserved Lemon, 380g
products.description: Villa Jerada Preserved Lemons are an essential Moroccan culinary tradition using small Beldi lemons, salt and time to give a bright citrus, complex umami flavor to a variety of dishes.

products.subtype: 아시아 소스/간장/미소 (Soy, Miso, Fish Sauce & Asian Sauces)
products.name: Villa Jerada Tahini, 16oz
products.description: Villa Jerada's Tahini is made from stone ground, small batch roasted sesame seeds, resulting in an extra creamy texture. It is a vital ingredient for hummus, but also can be spread over toast, whipped into smoothies, or baked into cookies.

products.name: Weak Knees Gochujang Sriracha, 10.5oz
products.description: Made by Bushwick Kitchen in Brooklyn, USA. The sweet-spicy flavors of a classic sriracha meet the fermented complexity of gochujang chile paste. Like nothing you've ever tasted - the perfect choice on anything where you would normally reach for traditional sriracha sauce. Breakfast sandwiches, eggs, dressings, fried rice, you name it.

products.name: Col. Pabst Worcstershire, 8oz
products.description: We were very excited to recieve this product a few years ago and it remains one of our favorite items in the store. This is NOT your usual bland Worcstershire sauce with wierd ingredients. This is a recipe that goes back generations and will be useful in your kitchen in many different ways!

products.name: Aardvark Habanero Hot Sauce, 8oz
products.description: Secret Aardvark Trading Co. was founded in Portland in 2004. They started selling their hot sauce at farmers markets, and now their sauces can be found as far east as NYC. A staff favorite, this sauce is made with habanero peppers and roasted tomatoes. Truly versatile, it makes a great topping for almost anything - pizza, french fries, sandwiches, fried rice or marinades.

products.name: Aardvark Serrabanero Green Hot Sauce, 8oz
products.description:
Secret Aardvark Trading Co. was founded in Portland in 2004. They started selling their hot sauce at farmers markets, and now their sauces can be found as far east as NYC.

Their Serrabanero Green Hot Sauce combines serrano and habanero chili with tomatillos, green tomatoes and spices to get the mythical flavor of Serrabanero. It is a tad spicier than you might expect for a green hot sauce but not at the expense of flavor.

products.name: Agostino Recca Anchovies in Olive Oil Tin, 50g
products.description: What began in the 1930's as a small family-run business has grown into one of the most recognized and well respected companies specializing in the canning of quality fish in Italy. These anchovies are carefully boned and filleted by hand and preserved in Sicilian olive oil. Use in sauces, on sandwiches, with pasta, or on pizza.

products.name: Benedicta Mayonnaise, 8.3oz
products.description: Benedicta Mayonnaise will give you the European tang you have been searching for since your last trip to France! This is NOT Hellmann's!

products.name: Black Garlic Molasses, 8.45oz
products.description: This black garlic molasses is a testament to the glories of aged foods. Through its heated aging process, black garlic loses the characteristic “bite” of fresh garlic, giving way to notes of caramel, tamarind, raisin, and balsamic. A bit sweet, a bit savory, and undeniably flavorful, it will add depth and complexity to just about any dish. It’s particularly tasty when paired with grilled meats, in burgers, or in stir fries.

products.name: Bonache Habanero, 6oz
products.description: Handcrafted in Ballard, USA, Bonache makes high quality, delicious sauces in small batches. Their Habanero Sauce is their flagship - mid-level heat, Belize-inspired hot sauce is made with sweet carrots, habanero peppers and lime juice. Great on eggs, tacos or on anything else you want to spice up!

products.name: Bonache Hatch, 6oz
products.description: Handcrafted in Ballard, USA, Bonache makes high quality, delicious sauces in small batches. Mild in heat, this sauce is made with the famous New Mexico Hatch chili pepper, fresh cucumbers and tomatillos. Great on everything!

products.name: Bonache Piri, 6oz
products.description: Handcrafted in Ballard, USA, Bonache makes high quality, delicious sauces in small batches. Hot and spicy, this Portuguese-style sauce is made with roasted tomato, Piri Piri peppers and lemon juice. Not for the spice-averse, it packs a punch.

products.name: Bonache Socorro, 6oz
products.description: Handcrafted in Ballard, USA, Bonache makes high quality, delicious sauces in small batches. Named after the town in New Mexico that the founder grew up in, this medium-high heat sauce is made with dried New Mexico chilies, fresh yellow radishes and lemon juice. Unique in flavor and great on everything!

products.name: Edmond Fallot Mustards 4pk, 100g
products.description:
Edmond Fallot has been an independently owned family business in the Burgundy region of France since 1840. With only 20 people working in their production facility, you can be assured that there is great care taken to create some of the best mustard, vinegar and pickles you will ever have.

Add an assortment of color and flavor to charcuterie trays and cheese boards with this collection of mustards from Edmond Fallot. Packaged in portion-sized jars, this four-pack includes dijon, honey-balsamic, blackcurrant and seed-style mustard. Sweet and savory, they're the perfect companion to crunchy crackers and cured meats.

products.name: Gabriele Rocchi Pistachio Spread, 230g
products.description: Gabriele Rocchi is an artisan baker in Firenze (Florence). He uses only the finest regional Italian ingredients in his batch made dolci. This spread is made using the finest ground Mediterranean Pistachios, sugar and EVOO for a delicous addition to any meal or dessert!

products.name: Garliki Fermented Garlic Culinary Paste Original, 170g
products.description: Simply put, GARLIKI "ORIGINAL" is a premium replacement for minced garlic. It is a versatile culinary "tool" crafted with just 3 ingredients: Garlic, Jacobsen Oregon Sea Salt, and Lime Juice. The much-loved flavor of garlic is transformed and intensified by using a spontaneous fermentation technique that leaves you with a savory cooking paste, ready for action!

products.name: Garliki Fermented Garlic Culinary Paste Umami, 170g
products.description: Garliki UMAMI will revolutionize your cooking experience, and we don’t make that claim lightly. The pungency and zing of fermented garlic is combined with ORGANIC CHICKPEA MISO (soy free!) to create a rich, slightly earthy, and intensely savory paste for a delightful culinary epiphany. Be prepared to take your favorite dishes to new places!

products.name: Garliki Fermented Garlic Culinary Paste with Herbs, 170g
products.description: Garliki HERBE is a robust blend of old world herbs and fermented garlic to create an instant fusion of flavor ready to apply to your favorite dishes. Goes great w/ bread, sauces, pizza, dips, dressings, veggies and more!

products.name: Guero y Maria Ghost Pepper Extra Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description: Experience the fiery yet balanced flavor of Güero & María's Ghost Pepper Hot Sauce. Made with fire-roasted ghost peppers, chiltepin, onions, garlic, sea salt, and a blend of spices, this sauce delivers a bold heat with smoky undertones and a touch of savory depth. The roasting process enhances the natural flavors of the ghost peppers, creating a sauce that’s perfect for carne asada, grilled meats, and more.

products.name: Guero y Maria Habanero Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description: Experience the fiery yet smooth heat and nuanced flavor of Güero & María's Habanero Hot Sauce. They carefully blend fermented habanero peppers from Becerra Gardens in Quincy, WA, with organic carrots, garlic, and onions, creating a sauce that’s intensely hot yet surprisingly balanced. The fermentation process mellows the raw heat of the habaneros, unlocking a complex profile with hints of natural sweetness and savory depth. Crafted with care, this sauce is a tribute to local ingredients and bold, authentic flavor!

products.name: Guero y Maria Salsa Verde Medium Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description: Experience the vibrant flavors of Northern México with Güero & María's Salsa Verde. They blend fresh tomatillos, jalapeños, serranos, and smoky chiles de árbol with crisp onion, garlic, and hand-chopped cilantro. Their slow fermentation process unlocks layers of tangy, earthy, and smoky depth, creating a salsa that's both complex and craveable. Inspired by the rustic kitchens of Northern México, this salsa is a true taste of the region.

products.name: Les Moulins Mahjoub Traditional Tunisian Harissa, 6.5oz
products.description: Les Moulins Mahjoub, located in Tehourba, Tunisia, makes traditional products, mostly by hand. Their harissa, the classic Tunisian condiment, is made with all-natural, organic ingredients and gets its heat from roasted chili peppers. It’s seasoned with garlic, cardamom, salt, coriander, and extra virgin olive oil. The harissa has a grainy texture. Use it to add flavor, color, and heat to sauces or as a bold, vibrant condiment. Excellent with eggs, vegetables, and meats.

products.name: Maille Old Style Dijon Mustard, 207g
products.description: The vision of La Maison Maille is as true today as it was over 270 years ago - use the highest quality ingredients to create amazing flavors and memorable meals. This mustard is a key ingredient on your condiment shelf. Made with crisp, whole seeds, this mustard has a grainy texture and powerful punch. Perfect in sauces and marinades, with country pate, or on a classic ham sandwich.

products.name: Maille Original Dijon Mustard, 213g
products.description: The vision of La Maison Maille is as true today as it was over 270 years ago - use the highest quality ingredients to create amazing flavors and memorable meals. This traditional Dijon dates back to 1747! A indispensable ingredient on your condiment shelf, this classic mustard has a smooth, creamy texture and a pleasant heat. Perfect for chicken and fish recipes, on a sandwich or in dressings and marinades.

products.name: Mama Africa Pili Pili Sauce, 5oz
products.description: As the story goes, Mamy Monique Mpunga wa Muamba Miwa Tshilombo, Ntita Mukai, is the best cook ever. Coming from the Bakwa Bilonda Tribe in the Kasai Region of the Congo (DRC), thousands of miles away, in The heart of Africa, she inherited these recipes from her Mom, Mamu Mtongo wa Mfwamba, who we called "Mimi". In 1966 the recipe was refined the beautiful authentic African salsa that is call "pili-pili" or "Ndunga". Mama Africa will never eat without Pili-Pili on her table. She carries a jar with her at all times. Mama says "pili-pili will keep you warm and bless you with vitamins." She says also that the mosquitoes will never touch your spicy blood. Great hot sauce AND no mosquitos! Score!

products.name: Marshall's Bird's Eye Basil Sauce, 5oz
products.description: Fresh, glossy, peak-of-summer basil has an intoxicating perfume all its own, and this floral, fresh sauce is a celebration of that iconic warm-weather herb. To extract every last bit of basil’s powerful aroma, Marshall's steeps it in white balsamic vinegar, and then reduces it to a densely herbaceous elixir. Leeks add a hint of sweetness, while the slightly fruity Thai bird's eye chili and jalapeños add layer upon layer of chili fire to this versatile sauce. Perfect on eggs or in a Bloody Mary!

products.name: Marshall's Habanero Carrot Curry Sauce, 8oz
products.description: Bursting with lightly sweet heat, this balanced, goes-with-everything sauce is one of Marshall's most popular. Sunset-hued habaneros grown by Sunrise Organic farm pack serious heat, but they also have a strong fruity, floral quality. The famously hot peppers play well with fresh carrots from Winters Farm, while a bit of homemade mustard and turmeric enliven the already-vibrant color of this sauce.

products.name: Marshall's Heirloom Habanero Sauce, 5oz
products.description: This ultra-hot, straightforward habanero hot sauce is good to pour on just about anything! The simplicity of the sauce is all about the beautiful vibrancy of the beloved habanero pepper. This makes it a great match for pizza, burritos, or to spice up whatever you intend on eating!

products.name: Marshall's Red Chili Lime Sauce, 8oz
products.description: Inspired by sweet chili sauce, Marshall's red chili lime hot sauce incorporates the heat of red jalapeños from Sunrise Organics into the fruity sweetness of ripe tomatoes from Eloisa Organic Farm. Local honey from Portland-area hives add a hint of sweet, while a spritz of fresh lime brings it all into harmony. With a bold flavor and smooth texture, it’s ideal for pouring liberally on everything from avocado toast to bento bowls.

products.name: Marshall's Serrano Ginger Lemongrass Sauce, 8oz
products.description: Fragrant and well-rounded, this assertive hot sauce uses citrus to balance the heat of serrano peppers and bridge the aromatic qualities of ginger and lemongrass. Start slow and be forewarned...the serrano chili heat has a delayed fuse because of the power of the other ingredients. We love to serve this sharp, vegetal hot sauce with fish and poultry.

products.name: Marshall's Smoked Habenero BBQ Sauce, 8oz
products.description: This sauce won first place in The Scovie Awards! It was created by deconstructing traditional big name barbecue sauces, cherry-picking their favorite flavors and then eliminating common allergens (gluten, anchovies, Worcestershire, corn starch). Marshall's replicated and replaced them respectively with a carefully-chosen array of spices and locally-grown vegetables. Smoky, a bit spicy, with a lovely warmth from cinnamon and clove, this sauce is accessible to all BBQ fans while standing in a category all its own. From burgers to ribs to grilled chicken, use it anywhere you’d use your favorite barbecue sauce!

products.name: Marshall's Whiskey Smoked Ghost Pepper Sauce, 5oz
products.description: We love a good cocktail, and we love that Marshall's brings their favorite spirits into the hot sauce kitchen with them, too! Ol' Uncle Nearest distills Whiskey, and it's this whiskey that is used to develop this smoky, booze-kissed sauce. Onions get a long, slow roast in a mixture of Uncle Nearest 1856 Whiskey along with the addition of apple cider vinegar for sweetness & acidity. If that's not enough, dates and dried ghost peppers also get a nice long whiskey soak before combining all those liquored up ingredients for a silky-smooth, slightly smoky, fiery hot sauce with an unmistakable whisky bite . Try it on grilled meats or roasted root vegetables.

products.name: Martin Pouret Mayonnaise with Tarragon, 170g
products.description: Martin Pouret Tarragon Mayonnaise is a rich, artisan French condiment from Orléans made with free-range egg yolks, sunflower oil, signature Orléans mustard, and 5% fresh tarragon. It features a creamy texture with bright, sweet aniseed herbal notes.

products.name: Momofuku Mild Garlic Chili Crunch, 5.5oz
products.description:
Momofuku's Mild Garlic Chili Crunch is everything you love about their Original Chili Crunch, without the fiery kick. They amped up the garlic and onions so each bite is full of crunch and flavor.

Mellow, garlicky heaven. They packed this one with aromatics like crispy shallots, garlic, and onions to make the ultimate savory-crunchy oil. Then they added mild California chilis for a richer, rounder taste. These chilis add flavor, not fire.

products.name: Murder Hornet Black Label Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description:
Kevin and Ryan started making hot sauce in a test kitchen in Kirkland. What set's them apart? Quality ingredients, unrushed cooking techniques, just the right amount of heat & a perfect pour. They're sauces are great and by purchasing them, you are supporting real people doing great work!

Bold, balanced, powerful. Black Label offers hot sauce enthusiasts a modern approach to ghost pepper heat. Complexity reigns supreme as the flavor profile begins slightly sweet, transitioning to citrus and umami notes that support that classic ghost pepper burn. Try it with ramen, burgers or wood-fired pizza. Naturally gluten-free.

products.name: Murder Hornet Blood Orange Agave Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description:
Kevin and Ryan started making hot sauce in a test kitchen in Kirkland. What set's them apart? Quality ingredients, unrushed cooking techniques, just the right amount of heat & a perfect pour. They're sauces are great and by purchasing them, you are supporting real people doing great work!

An attractive blend of roasted habanero and red fresno chili peppers with bright citrus notes of blood orange, grapefruit and lime zest. Quickly becoming a crowd favorite, this versatile hot sauce boasts a rich flavor profile that covers your tastebuds like a warm tropical sunset. Ginger, mustard seed, and cumin add intriguing complexity after the sweet organic agave nectar prelude. Perfect for pork, shrimp tacos, baked salmon or fresh oysters. Naturally gluten-free.

products.name: Murder Hornet Honey Bourbon Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description:
Kevin and Ryan started making hot sauce in a test kitchen in Kirkland. What set's them apart? Quality ingredients, unrushed cooking techniques, just the right amount of heat & a perfect pour. They're sauces are great and by purchasing them, you are supporting real people doing great work!

Roasted habaneros, red fresno chili peppers and black garlic create a deep and slightly smoky flavor that hits you with a savory sting. A sweet start of pure clover honey and brown sugar provides the prelude to the classic habanero back-end burn. Aged 4 years in American white oak barrels, the premium bourbon we select adds a refined depth while presenting the bridge between sweetness and heat. Try it on your eggs, steak, hamburgers, or mac 'n' cheese. Naturally gluten-free.

products.name: Murder Hornet Mango Verde Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description:
Kevin and Ryan started making hot sauce in a test kitchen in Kirkland. What set's them apart? Quality ingredients, unrushed cooking techniques, just the right amount of heat & a perfect pour. They're sauces are great and by purchasing them, you are supporting real people doing great work!

Bright, balanced, tangy. Mango Verde is the preferred choice for those who enjoy a refreshing, subtly sweet addition to their favorite traditional verde cuisines. With an appropriate amount of mild heat, this is a hot sauce for the whole family. Try it on carnitas, fajitas, street tacos or eggs benedict.

products.name: New York Shuk Harissa BBQ Sauce, 14oz
products.description:
New York Shuk is a maker of handcrafted Middle Eastern pantry staples. The word shuk means "market" in Hebrew, and for Ron and Leetal, the marketplace represents the center of a community - the meeting point where commerce and culture come together. They try to bring this communal energy, as well as the freshness of a bustling outdoor market to everything they do at New York Shuk.

A new American classic is born with their Harissa BBQ Sauce! Smokey from sun-dried chili peppers, and sweetened with Medjool dates, This finger-licking better-for-you sauce was created to help you build big flavors with ease, so you can spend less time in the kitchen and more time around the table.

One sauce, infinite uses - Marinate wings, ribs, salmon, brisket, tofu...flavor beans, roasted veggies, sandwiches, & burgers..dip fries, nuggets, and basically everything else!

products.name: Nong's Khao Man Gai Sauce, 12oz
products.description: Originally from Bangkok, Thailand, Nong moved to Portland in 2003 with $70 and two suitcases. Shortly after, she opened a small food cart designed to sell just one thing: Khao Man Gai. This traditional Thai chicken dish consists of poached chicken with Thai aromatics, rice and broth - it is served with a sauce made from fermented soy bean puree and mixed with garlic, ginger, thai chilies, vinegar and sugar. Garnished with a few pieces of cucumber & cilantro, it is a Thai staple. This is her handmade sauce, and the only sauce you can use to replicate this amazing dish. Its use does not stop there, though. It is also great as a marinade or a sauce with chicken, pork or fish.

products.name: Pistacchiosa Sicilian Pistachio Spread, 250g
products.description: Pistachios get the luxury treatment in this unbelievably smooth, sweet pistachio spread from Il Colle del Gusto. Extra-virgin olive oil lends a glossy sheen and velvety texture, but the flavor is all pistachio. The high percentage of Sicilian pistachio paste in this dreamy jarful makes for an intensely nutty flavor and aroma that enchants the second you pop open the lid. Pistachio lovers will want to eat it right out of the jar, but you can also use Il Colle del Gusto Pistacchiosa as you would chocolate sauce, spooned over fresh ricotta cheese or frozen yogurt or stirred into rice pudding.

products.name: Portlandia Foods Organic Ketchup, 14oz
products.description: Love ketchup but don't like not being able to pronounce all the ingredients on the back? Now you have a choice. Portland Ketchup is a game changer - tomato puree, vinegar, sugar, salt, onion, allspice and clove. Easy ingredients to pronounce, and good to eat. Use it whenever you crave some ketchup.

products.name: Portlandia Foods Organic Mustard, 13oz
products.description: Portland Mustard is a delightfully smooth and creamy reinvention of classic American yellow mustard with a hint of crushed black pepper. This is the perfect companion for your hot dogs, sausages, sandwiches, potatoes, or house-made dressings.

products.name: Queen Majesty Cocoa Ghost Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description: Queen Majesty hand selects the best ingredients available and makes their hot sauce every week in their commercial kitchen in NYC. Cocoa Ghost combines rich black cocoa powder with luscious pineapple, chipotle, and ghost pepper for a sweet, smoky depth and a remarkable, lingering heat. Perfect on tacos, burgers, and more, or mix it with your favorite BBQ sauce to make it sing! Very Hot!

products.name: Queen Majesty Hot Sauce Trinity, 6oz
products.description:
Queen Majesty hand selects the best ingredients available and makes their hot sauce every week in their commercial kitchen in NYC. The result is really good hot sauce that is produced with care.

products.name: Queen Majesty Jalapeno, Tequila & Lime Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description: Queen Majesty hand selects the best ingredients available and makes their hot sauce every week in their commercial kitchen in NYC. The result is really good hot sauce that is produced with care. The three ingredients on the label of this hot sauce say it all - jalapeno, tequila & lime. It is refreshing with a warm, satisfying heat. We know you are already getting ideas but here's a few more - grilled white fish, egg sandwiches, guacamole & tacos!

products.name: Queen Majesty Morita Mesquite Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description: Queen Majesty hand selects the best ingredients available and makes their hot sauce every week in their commercial kitchen in NYC. The result is really good hot sauce that is produced with care. Morita Mesquite is their newest limited edition. They wanted something that landed somewhere between a hot sauce and a BBQ sauce but was more versatile and had no added sugar. They highlight the chipotle morita pepper, a lightly smoked, ripe, red jalapeño, and the dried bean of the mesquite tree, which adds a subtle, flavorful nuttiness. Medium hot.

products.name: Queen Majesty Red Habanero & Black Coffee Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description: Queen Majesty hand selects the best ingredients available and makes their hot sauce every week in their commercial kitchen in NYC. Balanced by subtle notes of coffee that give it a deep smokiness, it's excellent chilis and stews - also perfect to mix with ketchup for your burger & fries!

products.name: Queen Majesty Sicilian Scorpion Hot Sauce, 5oz
products.description: Queen Majesty hand selects the best ingredients available and makes their hot sauce every week in their commercial kitchen in NYC. The result is really good hot sauce that is produced with care. HOT ONES Season 26 collaboration Sicilian Scorpion Hot Sauce is WILDLY HOT! We used delicious Sicilian ingredients, but beware of the intense sting of the Trinidad Moruga scorpion pepper. This sauce will add EXTREME HEAT and fresh flavors to your world. Turn up the heat on your pasta recipes, use as a heat accelerator for your Buffalo wings, and fire up your favorite hearty soups and chili.

products.name: Rancho Gordo Felicidad, 4oz
products.description: Rancho Gordo Felicidad Hot Sauce is a rich mix of pumpkin seeds and spices with the smoked chiles. It will almost make you think that there are tomatoes added, but it's all chile's that you're tasting!

products.name: Rancho Gordo Gay Caballero, 4oz
products.description: Rancho Gordo Gay Caballero is a blend of cinnamon and cloves along with zesty arbol chiles. Tasty, untamed and fancy just like you!

products.name: Rancho Gordo La Paloma, 4oz
products.description:
Rancho Gordo La Paloma is "Mild Sauce for Hot People!"

Not everyone wants to glow all the time. Sometimes a person just wants the flavor of chiles without all the perspiration.

products.name: Rancho Gordo Rio Fuego, 4oz
products.description: Rio Fuego is hot but not stupid hot. There are complex flavors and textures and it's a unique entry in the crowded world of hot sauces. Bold Chile flavor tamed by pumpkin seeds and vinegar!

products.subtype: 아시아 소스/간장/미소 (Soy, Miso, Fish Sauce & Asian Sauces)
products.name: Red Boat Fish Sauce, 250ml
products.description: This is the best tasting fish sauce in the world! Made using a 200-year old artisanal process - the fish are salted immediately after leaving the sea and then aged for a year in traditional wooden barrels. Used with everything from lamb to halibut, this aromatic and savory sauce is vital to many southeast Asian recipes.

products.name: Sable & Rosenfeld Olive Bruschetta, 454g
products.description: This is a flavorful blend of green olives, carrots, cauliflower, red bell pepper, celery and capers in olive oil. Perfect on sandwiches, grilled bread, pizza, salads, pasta, chicken or potato salad.

products.name: Salsa Espinaler, 3.11ml
products.tagline: Open a can of your favorite tinned fish...add a few glugs!
products.description: This classic Spainish appetizer sauce is great on everything. Once you go here, you don't go back. Douse your chips, olives, any tinned fish & salads. Mix it into marinades and dressings - it makes everything better!

products.name: Secret Aardvark Reaper Smoked Hot Sauce, 8oz
products.description:
Secret Aardvark Trading Co. was founded in Portland in 2004. They started selling their hot sauce at farmers markets, and now their sauces can be found as far east as NYC.

The heat intensity in their Reaper Smoked Hot Sauce will wake up your tastebuds but won’t melt your face! Well, maybe just a little. This is not a vinegar forward sauce, Aardvark Reaper Smoked Hot Sauce is a great addition to your red beans, burrito, pizza, and more! You’ll be surprised by how much you love the smoky heat!

products.name: Secret Aardvark Red Scorpion Fiery Hot Sauce, 8oz
products.description:
Secret Aardvark Trading Co. was founded in Portland in 2004. They started selling their hot sauce at farmers markets, and now their sauces can be found as far east as NYC.

Just like the genus of Scorpions, this hot sauce has a sting! Made with roasted tomatoes, carrots, and fermented scorpion peppers to add a sharp sourness. While it is a bit hotter than our flagship Aardvark Habanero Hot Sauce, we don’t sacrifice flavor for heat.

products.name: Sobelini Pizza Crunch Original, 170g
products.description: Sobelini Original Pizza Crunch was born in Italy to spice up the slice. Blending traditional Asian techniques with classic pizza toppings, it’s both new and familiar.
